app.invoice_unreachable: Could not reach the server for the invoice.
app.open_in_telegram: Open this inside Telegram to pay with Stars.
app.no_files: No files yet · add media in /admin
app.no_posts: No posts yet · add them in /admin
app.contact_placeholder: Your message — a job, an ad, a question…
app.message_sent: Sent — thank you! The owner will get back to you.
app.message_failed: Could not send. Please try again.
admin.title: Admin
admin.login_help: Enter the admin password (set as ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env).
admin.lock: Lock — viewers pay Stars to see it
admin.categories_help: Create the buttons shown across the top of the gallery. A post can belong to up to 3.
admin.posts_help: An article with rich text, its own uploaded images and videos, categories, colored hashtags, plus like / stars / share.
admin.stats_help: Whole-app, per-photo and per-post engagement. Numbers in green are new since you last checked.
admin.messages_help: Sent from the About page. Each shows the sender's Telegram @username. Configure where new inquiries are forwarded under Settings → Contact.
admin.label: Label
admin.show_in_header: Show this icon in the top header (next to search)
admin.icon_help: Icon names: see tabler.io/icons — e.g. brand-tiktok, brand-instagram, brand-youtube, brand-x, mail.
admin.logo_help: Upload a logo image and it replaces the name in the top header, and also shows full-width on the About page. With no image, the header falls back to the logo text. Leave both empty and the app is unnamed.
admin.logo_size_help: The header scales any logo down to fit its 36px slot, so it can never push the buttons out — but a wide, short mark reads best. Transparent PNG is ideal.
admin.logo_text: Logo text (used when no image is uploaded)
admin.telegram_help: Used by the Forward / Copy-link / Share buttons so they hand out your Telegram mini-app address (t.me/…) instead of the raw https tunnel URL.
admin.link_help: Link becomes t.me/<bot>/<short name>. Leave the short name blank to use t.me/<bot>?startapp.
admin.contact_help: When someone sends a Job / Advertising message from the About page, the bot forwards it (with their @username) to this Telegram chat. A copy is always kept in the Messages tab even if this is blank.
admin.chat_id_help: Tip: message @userinfobot on Telegram to get your numeric chat id. You must have started your bot once so it can DM you.
admin.intro_help: A self-made video (muted, any length). It plays once on open, then reveals the gallery.
admin.show_in_header_short: Show this icon in the top header
admin.no_categories_hint: No categories yet — add some below.
admin.language_help: Applies to both the gallery and this admin panel.
admin.colors_help: Applies to the gallery. Reset returns everything to the built-in look.
admin.fonts_help: woff2 is smallest. Uploading replaces the built-in font everywhere it is used.
admin.stars_help: Controls where the voluntary Send Stars button appears.
admin.stars_unlock_note: Locked items always keep their Unlock button, whatever this is set to — otherwise paid content could never be opened.
admin.show_stars_item: Show Send Stars on this item
